name: mluk-agent-tools
description: Personal Claude Code tooling for GitHub-hosted projects: repository bootstrap, repository workflow (commit, PR, review, sync, kickoff), design-kit porting, deployment, safe server access, and business Russian copy.

plugins.name: mluk-bootstrap
plugins.description: Initialise or audit a repository's agent harness: AGENTS.md, project profile, skills, hooks, docs, and the layer model behind them. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: mluk-repo
plugins.description: Repository workflow driven by a project profile: commit, create-pr, promote, review, sync, start, task, update-docs. GitHub with gh; no tracker.

plugins.name: mluk-ru
plugins.description: Business Russian for client-facing, legal and documentation texts: the principles, the self-check, the checklist, and a review command.

plugins.name: mluk-ops
plugins.description: Safe agent access to project servers: srv with an audit log, a guard hook (reads pass, changes ask, irreversible commands go to the owner) and the server-ops protocol.

plugins.name: mluk-deploy
plugins.description: How personal projects are deployed: a Compose stack on a VPS behind Caddy with GitHub Actions, a Next.js front on Vercel, and moving DNS to Cloudflare without breaking mail. Skills only.

plugins.name: mluk-design
plugins.description: Working against a design kit: porting it into the codebase and handling a kit that is itself wrong. Enable where a kit exists.
